title: A Review of Arabic Post-Training Datasets and Their Limitations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the availability, documentation, popularity, and community adoption of Arabic post-training datasets specifically categorized under 'Cultural Alignment' on the Hugging Face Hub.
Analyzing the linguistic representation gaps between Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and regional Dialectal Arabic (DA) in existing post-training and dialogue resources.
Surveying the presence, metadata quality, and scientific contribution of datasets explicitly categorized under 'Ethics, Bias, and Fairness' across 12 evaluated NLP domains.
